limits: Eight unrelated raw observation JSON rows are GitHub-mask damaged; no reconstruction. All ten alias source reports and both selected installed reports are intact.
CI alias callbacks use workspace emitted dist; local packed-consumer validation is distinct evidence. Package smoke separately checks tarballs.
Remote cleanup is callback-reported lifecycle/job completion, not independent remote process/filesystem census. Local cleanup remains separate.
Historical Read evidence remains its original 89-row artifact and historical identities, not new alias qualification. Counts do not establish profile completeness.
auditMethod: Read-only metadata/raw-log extraction and data assertions; no product execution. Source capture/missing/transition/drain/incident counters and HTTP status sequence inspected against selected contracts; installed binding, status, GET/HEAD metadata, lifecycle inspected. Historical localSensitivityControls is the two-item array admission-target/stale-postimage, not a numeric field.
